display.purpose: Hero and page-defining headlines on public surfaces only. Ceiling ~3.5rem.

title.purpose: Card titles and compact headings (leading-none, semibold).

body.purpose: Default reading text. Cap measure at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: The signature / SECTION_NAME marker, stats, timestamps, IDs. Monospace, muted, often uppercase.

shadows.name: hairline-lift
shadows.purpose: shadow-xs — outline buttons and inputs at rest.

shadows.name: resting-card
shadows.purpose: shadow-sm — cards, paired always with a full border.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only: popovers, dropdowns, dialogs, toasts.

motion.name: transition-all
motion.purpose: Default state transition on buttons and interactive chrome.

motion.name: transition-color-shadow
motion.purpose: Inputs and badges — focus ring and color shifts only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-emphasis action on a screen. Signal Orange, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.66 0.20 47.604); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Medium-emphasis action. Muted gray fill, no color.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0 0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis bordered action with hairline lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field. Hairline border at rest, Signal-Orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604 / 0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, border-defined container with subtle resting shadow. Never nested, never side-striped.
components.html:
Amsterdam AI Builders
A weekly gathering of engineers shipping with agents.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill status/label. Default carries Signal Orange; pair with a non-color cue for status.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: The signature house kicker. Monospace, muted, ruled. The single most recognizable element of the system.
components.css: .ds-section-label { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Quiet at rest, Signal Orange + non-color cue on active. Subtle hover bed, never aggressive.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); text-decoration: none; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.5); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.705 0.213 47.604 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: AIT Community is a town square where engineers and AI agents gather to build together. The square is built on a precise technical grid — monospace labels, OKLCH tokens, ruled borders, an orange-dot wordmark — but the grid is the pavement, not the point. Warmth comes from the people, the imagery, the language, and the disciplined use of a single warm accent. The system is balanced: one shared core of tokens, type, and components serves both the public square and the workshops behind it. Public surfaces get more expressive latitude; app surfaces are dense by necessity and earn warmth through clear hierarchy and human copy, not by stripping function. It explicitly rejects the generic-SaaS-template look, the cold sterile dashboard, crypto/Web3 hype, and corporate stuffiness.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-white (or true-dark) canvas, never tinted warm-neutral cream.
One warm accent — Signal Orange — used sparingly and on purpose.
Geist Sans for everything human; Geist Mono reserved for the house / LABEL voice, stats, and timestamps.
Border-defined, flat-by-default surfaces with subtle lift on interaction.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears on <=10% of any given screen. It marks the single most important action or the active state — nothing else. If two things on a screen are orange, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: The body background is pure white (oklch(1 0 0)) or true dark (oklch(0.145 0 0)). Never a warm-tinted near-white. The instant a surface drifts toward cream/sand/parchment, it reads as a generic AI-generated landing page.

rules.name: The Chart-Containment Rule
rules.body: The five chart hues live inside data viz and nowhere else. UI chrome is neutral + Signal Orange, full stop.

rules.name: The House Kicker Rule
rules.body: The monospace / LABEL is the one sanctioned eyebrow and it is a system, not decoration. Do not stack uppercase tracked eyebrows or 01/02/03 numbered markers on top of it.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Machine Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for the machine voice: labels, code, stats, IDs, timestamps. Warm human copy is Geist Sans. Monospace everywhere is how the town square turns cold.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting surface is border-defined and nearly flat. Reach for a heavier shadow only when an element is floating (overlay) or responding (hover/active).

rules.name: The Border-Carries-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated by borders and tonal steps first, shadow second. Removing every shadow should still leave the hierarchy legible.

dos: Do keep the body background pure white or true dark. Carry warmth through copy, imagery, and the accent — never a tinted cream surface.
Do ration Signal Orange to <=10% of a screen (the One Voice Rule).
Do use the monospace / LABEL as the one consistent section marker, and only there.
Do define surfaces with full hairline borders and tonal layering; reserve shadows for floating or responding elements.
Do pair every status color with a non-color cue (icon, label, pattern).
Do test headings and labels in both English and Dutch; layouts must absorb longer NL strings without overflow.
Do give every Framer Motion animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback, and ensure reveals enhance already-visible content.
Do keep body text >=4.5:1 (large >=3:1); never push text-muted lighter than oklch(0.556 0 0) on white.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS template look: no cream/sand backgrounds, gradient hero text, hero-metric blocks, or endless identical icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't let app surfaces become a cold, sterile dashboard — density is fine, all-gray soulless admin panels are not.
Don't drift toward crypto/Web3 hype: no neon-on-black, aggressive gradients, or 'to the moon' energy.
Don't go corporate/stuffy: no stock photography, navy-and-gray palettes, or jargon-heavy copy.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe (>1px) as an accent on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't nest cards, and don't give resting cards heavy soft shadows.
Don't stack extra eyebrows or 01/02/03 numbered markers on top of the / LABEL system.
Don't spend Geist Mono on warm human copy (bios, community descriptions).
Don't borrow chart colors into UI chrome.
